subject: Request: post-report extension letter for SOC 2 Type II
messages:
From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@sentinelhealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@sentinelhealth.com
Date: 2027-09-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request for post-report extension letter for SOC 2 Type II

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — Sentinel Health is moving quickly on vendor reviews. Our security team requested a short "continuity" or post-report extension letter to cover the period after Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report end date (report end: 2027-05-31) up through last Friday (2027-09-10).

Specifically they asked: can Redwood provide a one-page attestation confirming there have been no material changes to the control environment since 2027-05-31 and, if any, a brief note of remediation? We don't need a full re-audit — just a concise bridge-style statement our compliance team can attach to the vendor file.

Attached is our standard vendor request form for completion. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide this and an estimated turnaround?

Appreciate it — Aisha

Attachments: Sentinel_REQ_Form.pdf (procurement/vendor request form)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@sentinelhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-09-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request for post-report extension letter for SOC 2 Type II

Hi Aisha — thanks for the note and for sending the form. Yes, we can provide a short continuity statement that covers the period 2027-06-01 through 2027-09-10. I'll loop in our compliance lead (cc'd) to draft and review the language.

Estimated turnaround: 2 business days for an internal draft, faster if you confirm you just need Redwood's attestation (no external auditor signature).

Next steps: 1) I will share your form with our compliance and audit leads. 2) We’ll send a draft for your review. 3) Final will be delivered as a signed PDF or DocuSign if you prefer.

Also, please let me know if Sentinel requires the statement to reference specific controls or only a general assertion of continuity.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Karthik/Marissa — forwarding Sentinel's request (attached form). They need a one-page continuity assertion for the period 2027-06-01 -> 2027-09-10. Procurement is fine with Redwood-only attestation (no external auditor signature required), but they may ask for auditor-signed language if we prefer that route.

Can you: 1) confirm whether Compliance is comfortable signing a Redwood continuity letter that states no material changes since 2027-05-31; 2) draft a short paragraph we can send to the customer; and 3) let me know if Legal wants to review.

Note: Sentinel may want DocuSign, so a final PDF is ideal. I attached their request form to the thread.

Thanks — Vanessa

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-09-14T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Request for post-report extension letter for SOC 2 Type II

Vanessa — thanks for the heads up. I reviewed the request and drafted a concise continuity letter (attached). Summary of our position:

- We can provide a Redwood-signed continuity/extension letter that affirms: (a) our SOC 2 Type II report with period ending 2027-05-31 remains representative of our control environment up to 2027-09-10; (b) there have been no material changes affecting the controls covered by the report; and (c) where minor changes occurred, those were low-risk operational adjustments with documented remediation.

- I attached RDW_Bridge_Draft_v1.docx for internal review. It's intentionally short (one page) and references the report by title and period.

Action items for internal review: Marissa — can you confirm wording around "material changes" is consistent with audit practice and that we shouldn't reference any unreviewed remediation details? If Legal wants to limit liability we can add a short caveat line.

If we get the green light, I can finalize the PDF and route it for a Director-level sign-off. If Sentinel insists on auditor-signed language, we will escalate to the audit firm and update timelines.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Information Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com
